thread:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts reported from gateway-redwood-prod in us-west-2 after the 22:10 deploy. p95 latency increased from 120ms -> 1.8s; p99 ~ 7.2s. Error rate 5xx jumped to 4.6%. Paging oncall: @Asha

Asha (oncall): got the page, looking. Which deploy ID?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15_22:10:aa7f pushed to gateway-redwood-prod (canary->all).

Asha (oncall): thanks. @Diego can you grab traces and check the redis/kvcache latency? Maya are there any runtime changes in this deploy?

Diego (sre): pulling traces now. Seeing a spike in backend error responses from the router -> model-proxy layer, many 504s and upstream `context deadline exceeded`. Sampling top traces: requests are stalling waiting on kv cache fetches.

Maya (runtime): deploy included the new multiplexing path + a cache affinity tweak. We rolled the affinity change in canary then all. Rolling that back now if it's likely.

Asha (oncall): good call. Rob can you check node-level health and network errors?

Rob (infra): node metrics look normal CPU/GPU. Network retransmits up slightly on a subset of hosts (10.2.71.*). Kube liveness all green. I'm starting a curl test to the kv service from affected nodes.

Diego (sre): log snippet from router on one affected request: ```
proxy.go:342 handleRequest: upstream request timed out after 5s
kvcache.go:87 fetchPrefix: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```

Priya (product): any observed customer impact yet? Saw monitor alerts from two enterprise tenants - they reported timeouts in ingestion paths.

Asha (oncall): severity: customer-visible, some requests are getting 504s or long tails. Initiating rollback of deploy. Maya, start rollback of the affinity change. Diego, prepare a mitigation runbook and gather hit-rate / error-rate per customer.

Maya (runtime): rolling back config to previous affinity (imm healthcheck first). Command: ```
# rollback affinity config
redwood deploy-config set affinity_config=affinity-v2 --env prod --version prev
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started by Maya; rollback_id rb-241987-01. Progress: 1/3 regions.

Rob (infra): repro test: curling kv service from host 10.2.71.45 gives 200ms mostly, but intermittent 3-5s replies matching the tail. I'll cordon node 10.2.71.45 from serving while we validate.

Asha (oncall): cordon it and drain. Use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` and let us know when evicted.

Rob (infra): node cordoned and drained. Traffic rebalanced. Initial p95 down to 320ms, p99 to ~1.1s. Error rate dropping to 1.1% (from 4.6%).

Diego (sre): collecting affected request IDs: [r-83a, r-91b, r-2f7] and mapping to customers. Sending list to Priya for outreach.

Priya (product): got it. Notifying two impacted accounts and starting temporary status update: "We're investigating increased timeouts; engineers are rolling back a recent config change. We'll follow up in 30m."

Maya (runtime): rollback completed in us-west-2, starting global propagation. Confirming the affinity-config is at v1 on all gateway nodetypes.
deploy-bot: Rollback rb-241987-01: completed in us-west-2. Global propagation in progress.

Asha (oncall): monitoring for stabilization. Let's keep the deploy frozen until the postmortem. Diego, check if any retransmits/KV RPC saturation persists after propagation.

Diego (sre): after rollback p95 ~190ms, p99 ~420ms, 5xx down to 0.3%. No RPC saturation on kv clusters now. The one flaky node had hardware NIC errors per kernel logs, I'll file a ticket.

Rob (infra): filed infra ticket INF-241987 for NIC flaps on node 10.2.71.45. Isolated it from LB pool.

Priya (product): updating customers: "Issue mitigated by rollback; we are validating and will follow up with root cause and ETA for re-release."

Asha (oncall): handoff plan: I'm on-call for next 30m to watch aggregation; Diego + Maya to do deeper postmortem (traces + config diff). Rob to remediate hardware. Priya to coordinate customer comms and severity classification. Create an incident page and include the rollback id + customer hit list.

Diego (sre): creating incident page https://incidents.internal/redwood/2419876543 (notes: rollback rb-241987-01, affected customers: cust-ACME, cust-NOVA ingestion pipelines). Adding initial timeline and traces.

Maya (runtime): follow-ups: add gating for affinity config changes behind canary duration check and add a health-check that validates kvcache p99 before global rollout.

Asha (oncall): agreed. Quick remediation checklist posted to incident page. I'll escalate to SEV-2 until postmortem. If we see any regression or customers reporting errors, wake me. :phone: :rotating_light:

Priya (product): thanks all. Drafting postmortem notification for impacted customers and internal partners.

deploy-bot: Incident closed in channel when last_message_ts reached threshold (auto note).

Asha (oncall): closing thread for live mitigation; postmortem to follow. If anyone has additional logs, drop them into the incident page.
